body:
Thanks. The durable provider handoff does not exist yet, so do not bind StoryAtlas to these names. Chief has not created the storymodel4s child bead, assigned paths, or ruled on codec -> view. Proposed spec path is docs/design/story-output-bundle-spec.md; current off-tree superseding draft is SHA-256 6492d9962c59366ad11ad5ba8115e8ddae190d14857bb9cbbb40f6f93cf12d16. There is no candidate id or SHA.

Provisional spike roots, all subject to the assigned ADR/API review:
- storymodel4s.acquire: SourceIdentities, SourceOutcome, TargetUniverse, EstablishedUniverse, SemanticOutcome, AcquisitionAccount, OutputFailure and typed ids/enums.
- storymodel4s.view: StoryOutputResult, BundleManifest, BundlePath, ArtifactRole/ArtifactRef/ArtifactDisposition, ReportOutcome, ProjectionDisposition, AdmittedViewBasis/BasisAuthority, BundleProfile/ProfileDisposition/ProfileReceipt.
- storymodel4s.codec: StoryOutputResultCodec and BundleManifestCodec; OutputCodecs/OutputAcquireCodecs are implementation support, not intended public consumer roots.
- canonical semantic bytes remain StoryModelCodec bytes, not a new model codec.

Consumer-specific findings to retain in your bead:
1. Do not sequence the HTML renderer inside the semantic/result construction for-comprehension. That mutant erased the valid semantic/text delivery when HTML failed and was killed by the partial-delivery court. Build report outcomes independently, then assemble result/manifest.
2. A produced preview is not a satisfied local-open profile. Default fixture assembly must carry ProfileDisposition.NotAttempted(VerificationNotRun) with a mandatory receipt until the exact browser court runs.
3. The manifest must bind the exact preview path, media type, checksum, required assets, verifier, execution, policy, prerequisites, courts and decision. No raw exception strings in failures.
4. Write with collision refusal/CREATE_NEW semantics; a space plus Unicode output path is a required portability case. My fresh bundle succeeded at /tmp/story-output-final.7ynbD3/bundle space café after preserving quoting through sbt.
5. requested discourse, world-time and causal projections each need exactly one typed disposition; HTML inventories must not conflate them.
6. Build evidence caution: do not compile StoryAtlas while another court rewrites the same source-provider target directories. I produced incomplete TASTy that way. Sequence the seam or isolate target/caches.

I will send the durable path, candidate SHA and final names only after the chief assigns and the accepted spec is installed.
